senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; אָרַר)curse, evil; decrease, destruction, opp. בְּרָכָה.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 20b:12">Ber. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>תבא מ׳ וכ׳</he> curse (poverty) will come upon him &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:2:6">Y. Dem. II, 22ᵈ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 5:4:2">Y. Peah V, end, 19ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:5">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵇ</cite>; ib. 29ᵈ <he>נשלטה בהן מ׳</he> (not <he>ושלטה</he>) curse (poverty) was given power over them. Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Genesis 11">B’resh. 11</cite> <he>מה אנו מולידות למ׳</he> why should we give birth for curse (to see our offspring perish)?; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23:4">Gen. R. s. 23</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34:7">Gen. R. s. 34</cite>.—Sifra Thazr., Par. 5, ch. XIV (ref. to <he>ממארת</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 13:51">Lev. XIII, 51</cite>) <he>תן בו מ׳ וכ׳</he> put a curse on it (the garment) that no use be made thereof.
<cite ref="Beitzah 15b:10">Bets. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>הללו בעלי מ׳</he> these (being the last to leave) are poor men.

<cite ref="Tosefta Kiddushin 1:11">Tosef. Kidd. I, 11</cite> <he>תהא לה מ׳</he> (Var. <cite ref="M00606"><he>מורא</he></cite>) she will be cursed; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מְאֵרוֹת</he>, <cite ref="M00061"><he>מְאֵי׳</he></cite>.
Tosef. B. Bath. VI, 2 עשר מ׳ למאה (ed. Zuck. מרים לסאה) ten spoiled (bitter) pumpkins out of each hundred.
